scope: Within-method comparisons on the new batch (24 tasks per method, 5 seeds, inference registration). Each method is evaluated on its own tasks; there is no cross-method ranking.

metric_classes.rule: Conclusions rest on metrics the switched component does not optimize directly. Constrained metrics show only that the constraint took effect (section 8).

conclusion_metrics.accuracy: target error (m) and success within the method's tolerance (deck p.5; per task family: hand position error, waypoint / goal error, keyframe error)
conclusion_metrics.smoothness: jerk_0p1s (RMS third derivative of joint positions, 0.1 s difference step) and boundary jerk (differences across window junctions; autoregressive methods only)
conclusion_metrics.physical_feasibility: residual_force_rms_bw and residual_positive_share (evalkit residual, method floor)
conclusion_metrics.loads: leg muscle effort and reserve (evalkit muscle), L5/S1 compression (evalkit upper, lumbar subsample), net joint moments (descriptive: net moments are not loads)
conclusion_metrics.ergonomics: RULA and REBA class shares (certain_risk, certain_acceptable; evalkit ergo)
conclusion_metrics.distribution: FID on the official evaluation batches (on vs off within a method)

per_switch.chois.guidance: its foot-ground term: foot height relative to the method's own declared ground (world.json) and penetration are constraint checks for this switch; its hand-object term likewise makes hand-object distance a constraint check
per_switch.primal.ground_snap: foot height relative to the method's own declared ground and penetration
per_switch.kimodo.correction / ardy.correction: the constrained joints' error at the constraint frames (it is also the accuracy metric: reported, but a cost conclusion cannot rest on it)

bone_length_and_foot_height.decision: user 2026-11-09 00:06 review: bone length deviation and foot height relative to the method's own ground are not constrained metrics in general

bone_length_deviation.fk_methods: ARDY, Kimodo, PRIMAL, CHOIS (joints from rotations through forward kinematics): structural check, reported per method and condition (H_fk)
bone_length_deviation.joint_position_methods: MotionLCM, OmniControl, DART: mechanism outcome metric, analysed as a result of the switch (H_bone, H_dart)
bone_length_deviation.closd: structural check of the physics character (rigid bodies)

bone_length_and_foot_height.foot_height_relative_to_own_ground: constrained only under chois.guidance and primal.ground_snap; under every other switch an outcome metric of the foot-ground family

Q1_cost_of_guidance.question: What does each way of enforcing a spatial constraint (training layer, sampling layer, output layer) cost, and where does the cost fall: smoothness, foot-ground, physical feasibility or loads?

primary_contrasts.omnicontrol: spatial 1 - 0 at realism 1 (sampling layer); secondary: realism x spatial interaction (deck p.20)
primary_contrasts.kimodo: correction 1 - 0 (output layer) on the reused 416 pairs, labelled 're-check of data already seen in the deck' (PPT 已见数据的复核); these pairs are outside the development / held-out split
primary_contrasts.ardy: correction 1 - 0 at history_long 0 (output layer with write-back); secondary: correction x history_long

text_factor.methods: MotionLCM, OmniControl (CLoSD after its text interface is checked; inference registration)

estimands.guidance_cost: on - off within the consistent text
estimands.conflict_cost: (neutral - consistent) within guidance on: the extra cost when the text contradicts the control signal
estimands.deck_estimand: on - off within the neutral text (continues the deck's estimate)

Q1_cost_of_guidance.dose: risk-zone tasks (floor, knee, overhead; inference registration) are the dose variable: the contrast is reported per zone, and the zone x switch interaction is a registered secondary contrast

mechanism_hypothesis.H_bone: Joint-position representation plus in-sampling gradient guidance stretches bones: OmniControl spatial 1 - 0 bone length deviation > 0, larger in the risk zones than in the deck's 12 tasks (zone x spatial > 0)
mechanism_hypothesis.H_fk: Methods whose joints come from rotations through forward kinematics (ARDY, Kimodo, PRIMAL, CHOIS) keep bone length within numerical error in every condition (structural check, reported per method)
mechanism_hypothesis.H_dart: Counter-test: DART predicts joints and rotations separately (7 mm apart on the native matrix); its bone length deviation is reported with goal_update on and off, no direction registered
mechanism_hypothesis.measured_on: uncorrected outputs, source layer (no OpenSim), every row; never used to screen tasks or rows

Q2_effect_of_improvements.question: Do the junction treatments and history choices lower these costs at the same task accuracy?

primary_contrasts.primal: inertialization 1 - 0 (averaged over ground_snap and reprojection, deck p.25); secondary: ground_snap 1 - 0, reprojection 1 - 0
primary_contrasts.ardy: history_long 1 - 0 within correction 1 (write-back propagation, deck p.26)
primary_contrasts.closd: execution_context 1 - 0 (prefix from the physics execution vs the model's own prediction)

primary_metrics: target error (accuracy must not drop: reported next to every cost effect)
Q2_effect_of_improvements.later_comparators: the post-hoc correction group and the user's own method enter as comparators registered later (config/evalkit_batch_protocol_20261108.json, later_comparators); this plan reserves their slot and reports no result for them

Q3_ergonomics.question: How do RULA / REBA and the body loads change under the same switches?
Q3_ergonomics.primary_contrasts: the primary contrasts of Q1 and Q2
secondary_metrics: L5/S1 compression on the lumbar subsample
Q3_ergonomics.floor: loads and ergonomics primary on the self floor (v1.2); the method-floor values are the setting check below
Q3_ergonomics.risk_zone: the risk-zone tasks are where RULA / REBA can register risk at all (design section 1: the deck's targets sit in the comfort zone); per-zone results are reported
Q3_ergonomics.overhead_strategy: user 2026-11-09 (answer received between 03:17 and 03:21): in the per-zone results the overhead zone (MotionLCM and OmniControl tasks 16, 17, 22, 23) also reports, descriptively, the distribution of (a) the target-side upper-arm elevation relative to the thorax and (b) the trunk extension, per method x condition and per direction (front, side90), to separate the two ways of reaching an overhead target: raising the arm or leaning back (inference registration reach_geometry.overhead.definition: the zone is defined by world height and elevation against the vertical; in front a backward lean reaches it with a thoracic elevation of at most 67.8 deg). Definitions: (a) angle between the humerus long axis (humerus origin to ulna origin) and the torso body's downward axis on the evalkit-fitted Rajagopal model, the quantity of python/scripts/task_reachability.py elevation(); (b) evalkit ergo trunk_angles sagittal component (hip-joint midpoint to neck_c against the ground vertical in the pelvis sagittal plane), negative = extension, reported signed. Both at the IK frame nearest the task target time (2.5 s), computed from the cached IK fit of each evaluation (work/, no refit). Not implemented yet: before use, the implementation must agree with the angles() of python/scripts/task_reachability.py elevation() within 0.1 deg (约定) on every IK frame of existing evaluations of both methods (the reachability poses were not saved)

statistics.effect: paired difference on - off within (task, text, seed); mean over seeds; equal weight per task

interval.design: in the new batch the paraphrases rotate with the seeds, so text is crossed with task, not nested: every task carries all 5 paraphrases of its hand (rotation scheme: inference registration)
interval.primary: 95% percentile bootstrap with task clusters (each task with all its seeds and paraphrases); Kimodo: source motion as in deck p.23; 10000 resamples, seed 20261108 (约定，未经推演)
interval.cross_paraphrase: text x task crossed bootstrap: tasks and paraphrases resampled independently in each draw, every (task, paraphrase) cell weighted by the product of its task and paraphrase draw counts; reported next to the primary interval as the interval for generalizing over wordings; methods with a text table only (MotionLCM, OmniControl; CLoSD has no text factor: inference registration tasks.closd, user 2026-11-09 03:07); same resamples and seed (约定，未经推演)

statistics.fid_interval: official evaluation batch only: inference registration official_evaluation_batch.fid_interval (paired window resampling, both arms and the ground truth in sync)
statistics.dedup: rows with byte-identical inputs enter once (input sha256)
statistics.multiplicity: Holm within each question over the methods' primary contrasts, per primary metric, applied only in the primary setting (method floor for residual, self floor for loads and ergonomics, joint-line neck reading, registered thresholds); in the other settings of settings_robustness a conclusion needs the same sign and a raw (unadjusted) 95% interval excluding 0; secondary contrasts and metrics are reported without correction and labelled secondary (约定，未经推演)
statistics.key_effects: Holm uses the p value of the exact sign-flip test over task-cluster means; the Holm-tested effects also get a cluster t interval (as deck p.17)
statistics.validity_gates: evalkit gates as registered (IK error, unmeasurable frames); each arm's gate pass rate per evaluator is reported as a result for every primary contrast (per-arm rate and the paired on - off difference with the primary interval), not only used as a measurement-state flag; it is not in the Holm family; the primary set for the other metrics is pairs whose two runs both pass; all pairs reported as sensitivity

measurement_consistency.rule: an OpenSim-based effect is read directly only when the two arms are in the same measurement state (section 8)
checks: share of rows inside the +-0.5 cm threshold band
measurement_consistency.flag: any check differing by more than 5 percentage points (shares) or 0.5 cm (offset median) between the arms labels the effect 'measurement state differs', reported descriptively (约定，未经推演)

settings_robustness.rule: A main conclusion is written as a conclusion only if it passes Holm in the primary setting and has the same sign and a raw 95% interval excluding 0 in every other applicable setting; otherwise it is labelled 'setting-dependent' and reported with each setting's value (section 8)

floor.applies_to: every evalkit metric (residual, ergo, muscle, upper)

neck_reading.applies_to: RULA conclusions on ARDY, CHOIS, Kimodo, PRIMAL (config/evalkit_neck_supp_20261108.json; other methods: joint line only)

settings_robustness.not_settings: contact tolerance 2 / 3 cm is not a setting of the main batch (section 14 item 4): at most a descriptive check on a small subsample

descriptive_only: DART FID (user 2026-11-09 04:08): the BABEL evaluator (FlowMDM, vendored by DART) failed the noise-monotone self-check, its FID saturates under joint noise (21.7 at 2 cm, 24.4 at 5 cm, 23.5 at 10 cm; develop_logs/test_runs/20261107_evalkit/distribution/flowmdm_babel/selfcheck.json); no inference on it
overhead-zone upper-arm thoracic elevation and trunk extension at the target time (Q3_ergonomics.overhead_strategy)
every comparison between methods, including levels (medians per condition) and the subset FID
CHOIS loads (lumbar, leg muscle): hand-held object load not modelled until the mass source is decided (contract)
the reproduction subset (native matrix): sensitivity of the conclusions to the text wording
the rotation neck reading itself (no truth on generated motion)

split_use.baseline_conclusions: development set only (the split dimensions and rules: inference registration)
split_use.held_out: the baselines' held-out results are opened once, together with the user's own method, at its final comparison; until then no held-out evalkit summary, native metric or figure of any baseline is computed for viewing
split_use.enforcement: the batch writes held-out rows like any other row; the analysis scripts select the development set by the registered split and refuse held-out rows unless the final-comparison flag is given; opening the held-out set is recorded in the notes with its time and commit
split_use.fallback: user 2026-11-09 (answer received between 03:58 and 04:03): before any baseline conclusion is published externally (paper, formal presentation), a written decision is required and recorded in the notes with time and commit: either open the held-out set as a baseline held-out re-check, or state that the held-out set is reserved for the user's method and was not opened; the publication says which, truthfully
split_use.fallback_reading: registered now (user): per primary contrast, 'consistent' = same sign as the development point estimate and the held-out 95% interval covers the development point estimate; 'inconsistent' = opposite sign and the held-out interval does not cover the development point estimate; everything else 'underpowered, cannot be judged'; once opened, every primary contrast is reported, none selected. Held-out interval: the primary interval of statistics.interval on the held-out rows. ARDY has no held-out set (inference registration split.ardy_no_held_out, user 2026-11-09 04:08): its contrasts are reported as 'no held-out set', not judged
split_use.fallback_consequence: follows from design section 14 item 1 (baseline held-out results are viewed once): if the set is opened as a baseline re-check, it no longer serves the user's final comparison, which then needs a newly registered held-out set
split_use.kimodo_reuse: the reused 416 Kimodo pairs were already seen in the deck: they are labelled 'PPT 已见数据的复核' (re-check of deck-seen data) and belong to neither the development nor the held-out set
